QuestInfo.name: Starstruck
QuestInfo.0: It seems like the rumors were true... Blake is quite a...well, a jerk. Lana, one of his managers, wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Lana is disturbed that Blake changed so drastically after he got his fame. He never seems to listen. She wants you to help out with the autograph event because of how big it's gotten. Talk to Tina.
QuestInfo.2: Tina, Blake's stylist, also seems to be displeased with Blake. Still, she has to get the preparations done.

0.0: Sorry about Blake...he hasn't been getting much sleep, and it makes him cranky.\r\n#L0##bActually, I heard he's gotten pretty arrogant lately. Is that it?#l\n#k
0.1: Boy, rumors sure do spread fast. I can't lie... It's absolutely true. He's not polite like he used to be and he won't listen to anything I say. It's like he's a different person now...\r\n#L0##bHe's going to turn his fans away at this rate.#l\n#k
0.2: Right, his fans aren't dumb. I don't think anyone will stay loyal for long at this rate. I can't help but worry. We have the autograph event to worry about, too... Would you help me?

yes.0: I can't just cancel the autograph event just because of Blake's attitude. We must press on! Go find his stylist, Tina, and tell her to continue with the preparations. I'll try to talk to Blake myself.

no.0: You must be busy. And... I understand if your experience with Blake changed your mind.

1.0: What is it? Oh, the autograph event preparations? Well yeah, I have to do it since it's my job.

npc.0: Tell Tina to continue with the autograph event preparations.
